name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A modal panel anchored to one edge of the viewport — a nav drawer, a filter panel, a settings pane. Base UI's Dialog owns the open state, the focus trap, page inerting, Escape and outside-press dismissal; we own the scrim, the slide and the side geometry.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/sheet

Installed to `components/ui/sheet.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/sheet';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sheet

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
